direction: oaiy_to_aokie for transfer_cancel, aokie_to_oaiy for transfer_notice
about: OAIY withdraws a transfer request it asked for: its ring dialog was declined, the caller was offered a message instead, or it gave up waiting. Both frames ride the call's realtime stream, carry the session's callId and generation like every frame, and exist only on a session that negotiated transfer_v1. A cancel that withdraws a request is answered by the cancelled outcome itself (transfer-v1.outcome.fixture.json), once; a cancel that changes nothing is answered by a transfer_notice. It is not a connector command and is never relayed.

reasonMeaning.owner_declined: The person at the desk pressed Decline in OAIY's ring dialog.
reasonMeaning.message_instead: OAIY offered the caller a message instead (Take a message instead).

cases.name: the caller is being offered a message instead

ignored.about: A frame with no usable requestId or with a reason outside the closed set changes nothing and gets no reply (there is nothing typed to answer it with). It is never fatal. Members the plugin does not know are ignored.

cases.name: a reason outside the closed set
a requestId with characters outside the rule
a requestId that is not a string

noticeMeaning.too_late: An owner device has already won the request: the takeover is under way and is not affected. Expect the stop with handoff:takeover, or an unavailable outcome if the setup fails.
noticeMeaning.unknown_request: This call has no open request with that id: it never existed here, it belongs to another call, or it has already ended (including by an earlier cancel of the same id). Nothing was changed.

notice.atMs: Unix epoch milliseconds at which the plugin decided.

cases.name: no such open request on this call

behaviour.about: What the plugin does with a well-formed cancel, in the order it decides. It is handled exactly as a request withdrawn because someone took the caller another way: an acceptance since the last turn is seen first and wins.

cases.name: the request is ringing and nobody has won it
cases.result: withdrawn: the offers stop, the mailbox is freed, one cancelled outcome is sent, the audit event closes as cancelled. No notice.

cases.name: an owner device has won the request (accepted, or already bridged)
cases.result: left alone: the takeover continues. A too_late notice. No outcome.

cases.name: the request ended since OAIY last heard (declined, expired, failed) and the cancel crossed it
cases.result: the outcome of how it ended is what OAIY hears; the cancel changes nothing and gets an unknown_request notice.

cases.name: an id this call has no open request for (never seen, another call's request, a stale id)
cases.result: nothing changes; an unknown_request notice. A request of another call is never withdrawn.

cases.name: the same cancel sent twice
cases.result: the first withdraws (or is too_late); every repeat is an unknown_request notice (or too_late again while the request is still accepted). Effects happen once.

cases.name: a session that did not negotiate transfer_v1
